_note: Baseline ISO 8601 calendar date.
Day-first. Unambiguous only because 31 cannot be a month - see ambiguous_dmy_mdy.
Month-first. Same shape as dmy_slash and equally valid; nothing in the data distinguishes the two conventions.
The genuinely undecidable one: 2 January or 1 February. A pipeline that picks silently is wrong half the time. Only a declared format resolves it.
Offset-carrying timestamp. The same instant as utc_control - the specimen for whether the pipeline normalizes to UTC or drops the offset.
The UTC form of offset_positive. The two must land on the same instant.
ISO 8601 basic format. DuckDB TRY_CAST to DATE returns NULL, and the value is indistinguishable from a plain integer.
MySQL zero date. Not a date in any calendar; arrives from every MySQL source that ever allowed a NOT NULL DATE with no default.
Well-formed, calendrically impossible. A regex `pattern` rule passes it; only the cast rejects it - which is why `pattern` is never a substitute for `coercible`.
2023 is not a leap year. Impossible AND ambiguously formatted - two rules fire, and D18 precedence keeps the outcome deterministic.
A real leap day, to prove non_leap_feb_29 is rejected for its year, not its shape.
Second 60. Legal in UTC, representable in no SQL timestamp type.
Epoch seconds delivered as a bare integer. As a date string it does not cast; as epoch it is 1970-01-01. Undecidable without a declared transform.
The instant epoch_integer probably means. Present so a suite can assert the two agree once an epoch transform is declared.
The end-of-time sentinel every SCD2 implementation uses. Must cast cleanly - a quarantined 9999-12-31 closes every open SCD2 record (RFC 0010).
Unquoted empty - NULL. Per D19 no date rule fires; `not_null` owns it.
Month 13. Rules out the 'just swap the components' repair heuristic.
Day-first with ISO separators - shaped like an ISO date, ordered like a European one.
Locale-dependent textual month. Contains the delimiter, so it also exercises CSV quoting on the way in.
Excel/Sheets serial day number for 2025-01-01. Arrives from every spreadsheet export and casts to a perfectly plausible integer.
Quoted empty - the empty STRING, a non-null value that is not a date. Pairs with empty_field: `not_null` catches one of these two, `coercible` the other.
